summary.text: Bradley Moulton is the Republican candidate for Maine House of Representatives District 146 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Democrat Walter Runte Jr.
An attorney, he previously represented District 149 in the Maine House of Representatives from 2010 to 2012.

paragraphs.text: Moulton graduated from York High School, earned a bachelor's degree from Eastern College in 1974, and received a graduate degree and law degree from the Catholic University of America in 1979, according to Ballotpedia.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he worked as a reserve police officer in Ogunquit, served as a bail commissioner, and practiced law in Maine for 46 years.
He also listed service on the York County child abuse prevention council, the York Land Trust and the Ogunquit Playhouse Foundation.
Moulton won the November 2010 general election for Maine House District 149 and served on the Judiciary and State and Local Government committees in the 2011-2012 session.
He ran for re-election in 2012 and lost to Democrat Paul McGowan, 54.4 percent to 45.6 percent, according to Ballotpedia.
He advanced from the Republican primary for District 146 on June 9, 2026.
In the survey, Moulton said that unless families can reach a livable income of $100,000, they have difficulty making Maine their home, and that this guides his work on legislation.
He also said he has supported a mix of housing options to meet demand.
